facts.text: The Nebraska Promise covers undergraduate tuition costs after Pell grants and other scholarships are applied.

sources.title: Nebraska Promise | Financial Aid | University of Nebraska at Kearney
sources.quote: The Nebraska Promise covers undergraduate tuition costs after Pell grants and other grants and/or scholarships are taken into account.

facts.text: Through the New Nebraskan Tuition Waiver, eligible out-of-state undergraduate students pay the Nebraska in-state tuition rate.

sources.title: New Nebraskan Tuition Waiver | Financial Aid | University of Nebraska at Kearney
sources.quote: The University of Nebraska at Kearney helps eligible out-of-state undergraduate students pay the Nebraska in-state tuition rate through the New Nebraskan Tuition Waiver.
